output.title: New certificate timestamp metrics may appear in your Prometheus scrape
output.content: The change adds `certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds` and `certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds`. The environment's values set `prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled` and `prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort`, so cert-manager metrics are plausibly scraped. Inspect whether metric relabeling, allow-lists or cardinality limits on that ServiceMonitor would affect the new series. The summary does not show the values themselves.
